issues.title: Ingest the Metro Nashville budget
issues.learned: FY2027 $3.85B — Education (MNPS) is 37% of it, Public Safety & Justice 22%. One consolidated city-county budget since 1963. Foots by function to the dollar.

issues.title: Ingest the adopted ordinance & departments
issues.detail: The footing table is the Recommended budget; pull the adopted ordinance (Appendix 1) and the per-department detail to break Public Safety into Police/Fire/Sheriff.
